NFL DFS Defense Rankings: Week 10 (DraftKings)

DraftKings main slate · Sunday, November 15 · 10 games · By Chris Spags · · Numbers as of November 10, 10:42 AM ET

The Rams are the top-projected defense on the Week 10 DraftKings main slate at 8.5 DraftKings points for $3,800, at Arizona. Jaguars (7.5, $4,000) and Texans (7.5, $3,400) are next.

The Dolphins return the most per dollar among defenses projected for at least 6 points: 2.32 projected points per $1,000 at $2,600.

Every projection is a SPAGS model estimate from the November 10, 10:42 AM ET run of the Splash Play NFL model. This page updates each time the main-slate numbers are published.

Defenses to know in Week 10

Rams, LAR at ARI ($3,800)

Rams carries the highest SPAGS model projection at the position, 8.5 DraftKings points at $3,800. That is 0.9 points clear of Jaguars. The salary works out to 2.23 projected points per $1,000, 3rd of 9 at the position. Across 10,000 simulations Rams averaged 8.6 points with a simulated floor of -0.3 and a ceiling of 15.5, and it holds 15% of the simulated winning-lineup credit. The Rams are a 9.5-point favorite on the road against Arizona, with an implied team total of 25 in a game totaled at 40.5.

Value: Dolphins, MIA at IND ($2,600)

Dolphins projects for 6.0 DraftKings points at $2,600, which works out to 2.32 points per $1,000 of salary. That is the best rate of any player priced in the cheaper half of the 9 defenses the model projects for 6 or more points. Across 10,000 simulations Dolphins averaged 6.0 points with a simulated floor of -0.2 and a ceiling of 15.2, and it holds 6% of the simulated winning-lineup credit. Miami is a 2.5-point underdog on the road against Indianapolis, with an implied team total of 19 in a game totaled at 40.5.
